facts.fact: The Citizen reports, citing Vodacom Tanzania's Athumani Mlinga, that Tanzania has TZ-CERT, operating under the Tanzania Communications Regulatory Authority and coordinating responses to cybersecurity incidents.

TZA.note: No incident handled or alert stated.

facts.fact: The Citizen quotes Neurotech's Kalebu Gwalugano saying Tanzania has local data centre and cloud providers including Liquid, Wingu and the National Internet Data Centre, whose offerings mainly target government institutions and large organisations.
facts.system: Liquid, Wingu, National Internet Data Centre (NIDC)

TZA.note: No Tier or cloud region stated; a full public cloud region is only called for.
No rule stated; a speaker says forcing local hosting is not the answer.
ICTC director general speaks of digital sovereignty in general; no plan, rule or hosting of state data stated.
NIDC named but its ownership and government hosting are not stated.
Developers and startups mentioned only as cloud users.
